status: R1 ratchet plus R2 offers/interviews classification. Remaining domains are classified as their routes move.
rule: live_mutations - classified MUST NOT exceed baseline_unclassified. Adding a mutation route therefore fails the contract test until it is classified or this baseline is raised in review.

classified.response: offer view with offer_id, candidate_id, project_id, status
classified.concurrency: none - create-only, no If-Match or expected revision
classified.human_actor: yes - actor defaults to human; the offer is never created by AI
classified.invariants: candidate must exist (404) and be in interview or offer stage (409 invariant_conflict)
classified.side_effects: creates one OfferRecord row plus one audit event in the same transaction

classified.response: offer view with the new status
classified.concurrency: none observed - no If-Match/expected revision, so two clients race last-write-wins. Recorded as a gap, not a guarantee.
classified.audit: OFFER_STATUS_CHANGED with from/to status and candidate_id
classified.invariants: status must be a known OFFER_STATES value and must follow the allowed transition table (409 invariant_conflict)
classified.side_effects: mutates OfferRecord.status plus one audit event in the same transaction

classified.invariants: event/state allowlists; candidate exists; attached Source exists and belongs to candidate; structured completion may publish immutable evidence
classified.side_effects: creates RecruitmentEvent; may create Source + MaterialRevision; writes audit event

classified.invariants: event exists; state/metadata validation; structured evidence correction never mutates old Source and replaces only superseded Source in current material
classified.side_effects: updates RecruitmentEvent; may create superseding Source + MaterialRevision; writes audit event

classified.concurrency: none observed; submitted scorecards are locked by evaluator/event invariant
classified.audit: INTERVIEW_SCORECARD_SAVED or INTERVIEW_SCORECARD_SUBMITTED in the same transaction
classified.human_actor: yes - evaluator is the audit actor
classified.invariants: event exists; evaluator required; feedback ratings validated; submitted scorecard cannot be overwritten; opinions are not auto-averaged
